item.description: Telefilm Canada is currently accepting submissions for its 16th edition of CANADA: NOT SHORT ON TALENT program at Cannes, a curated market showcase presented at the Short Film Corner 2026. item.description: BreakOut West is a music industry showcase, conference, and festival, designed to match export-ready artists based in Western Canada with industry professionals. item.title: ShowHub: Connecting Vancouver’s Live Music Community
item.description: ShowHub is a centralized, accessible website that gathers and lists upcoming live music performances at small and mid-size venues across Vancouver and surrounding areas. It brings together information that’s often scattered across social media and individual websites, making it easy to see what’s happening on any given day. item.description: Vancouver, B.C. (February 5, 2026) – Today, the BC Arts Council and Creative BC are pleased to announce the recipients of their Interactive Fund partnership.
